name: Interpol

whyMatters.en: New York four-piece formed in 1997. Turn on the Bright Lights (2002, Matador) and Antics (2004) put Joy Division–echo bass, reverb guitar, and black-suit presentation back on early-2000s indie radio.
whyMatters.zh: 纽约四人组，1997 年成立。《Turn on the Bright Lights》（2002，Matador）与《Antics》（2004）把 Joy Division 回声贝斯、混响吉他与黑西装形象重新放上 2000 年代初 indie 电台。

lyricQuotes: I wish I could eat the salad off your head
Rosemary / Heaven restores you in life

shortBio.en: Banks/Kessler/Dengler post-punk revival; Obstacle 1 is the debut-era single.
shortBio.zh: Banks/Kessler/Dengler 后朋复兴；《Obstacle 1》是出道期单曲。

body.en:
Interpol formed in New York in 1997. Turn on the Bright Lights (2002) and Antics (2004) fixed a look and mix: black suits, delayed interlocking guitars, Carlos Dengler’s high-register bass, Banks’s restrained baritone.

Obstacle 1 (2002) is the clearest structural sample—tight verse, open chorus, melodic bass as hook. They share the NYC revival map with The Strokes but run colder and slower, closer to Joy Division and The Cure. Carlos D left in 2010; later records keep the name with a changed bass seat.
body.zh:
Interpol 于 1997 年在纽约成立。《Turn on the Bright Lights》（2002）与《Antics》（2004）定型外形与混音：黑西装、延时交织吉他、Carlos Dengler 高音域贝斯、Banks 克制男中音。

《Obstacle 1》（2002）是最清楚的结构样本——紧主歌、开副歌、旋律贝斯作钩子。与 The Strokes 共享纽约复兴地图，但更冷、更慢，更近 Joy Division 与 The Cure。Carlos D 于 2010 年离队；后期唱片在贝斯位变动后继续使用同一乐队名。

note.en: From Turn on the Bright Lights; tight verse, open chorus; Dengler bass melody as hook.
note.zh: 出自《Turn on the Bright Lights》；紧主歌、开副歌；Dengler 贝斯旋律作钩子。

note.en: Antics single; organ undercurrent, mid-tempo groove for second-album radio.
note.zh: 《Antics》单曲；风琴底流、中速 groove，服务二专电台。

note.en: Delay-heavy dual guitars, dry vocal; debut-album mood piece.
note.zh: 大量延时双吉他、干人声；首专氛围曲。

title.en: Joy Division echo on NYC indie radio
title.zh: 纽约 indie 电台上的 Joy Division 回声

body.en:
Interpol restored post-punk bass prominence and reverb guitar as mid-tempo writing—not garage speed. Turn on the Bright Lights (2002, Matador) arrived beside The Strokes but traded swagger for restraint.

Banks’s baritone and Kessler’s arpeggiated delay define the sound. Black-suit, black-and-white press photos are part of how the band was cited.
body.zh:
Interpol 把后朋贝斯前置与混响吉他恢复为中速写法——非 garage 速度。《Turn on the Bright Lights》（2002，Matador）与 The Strokes 同期，但用克制代替 swagger。

Banks 男中音与 Kessler 琶音延时定义声音。黑西装、黑白媒体照是乐队被引用方式的一部分。

body.en:
1997–2010 defining lineup: Banks, Kessler, Carlos D, Fogarino—dual guitar/bass division, no keyboard player on stage.

Antics (2004) adds organ textures in studio while keeping the same four names live. Carlos D’s 2010 exit shifts bass duties; Bright Lights and Antics remain the citation core.

Fogarino’s dry, forward kit keeps songs mid-tempo.
body.zh:
1997–2010 定义阵容：Banks、Kessler、Carlos D、Fogarino——双吉他/贝斯分工，台上无键盘。

《Antics》（2004）录音室加风琴质感，现场仍四人名。Carlos D 2010 年离队改变贝斯分工；Bright Lights 与 Antics 仍是引用核心。

Fogarino 干、靠前的鼓组让歌曲保持中速。

alt.en: Paul Banks of Interpol, Sziget Festival, 2011

title.zh: 2000 年代 indie 的后朋复兴参照

body.en:
Bass-forward mixes and delay guitar stacks were widely copied by gloom-leaning revival bands through the 2000s. Joy Division and The Cure are named ancestors; Interpol translated them for Matador-era indie radio.

UK acts including Arctic Monkeys shared chart timing; Interpol’s direct lineage is post-punk arrangement. Citation density peaks in 2002–04.
body.zh:
贝斯前置混音与延时吉他堆叠在 2000 年代被偏暗色的复兴乐队广泛模仿。Joy Division 与 The Cure 是点名来源；Interpol 为 Matador 时代 indie 电台翻译它们。

含 Arctic Monkeys 的英国乐队共享榜单时机；Interpol 的直接渊源是后朋编曲。引用密度峰值在 2002–04。

body.en: Tight verse, open chorus; Dengler bass melody carries the hook on the debut album.
body.zh: 紧主歌、开副歌；Dengler 贝斯旋律在首专上承担钩子。

body.en: Antics single with organ undercurrent and mid-tempo swagger for second-album radio.
body.zh: 《Antics》单曲：风琴底流与中速 swagger，服务二专电台。

body.en: Delay-heavy dual guitars and dry vocal; a mood piece from Turn on the Bright Lights.
body.zh: 大量延时双吉他与干人声；出自《Turn on the Bright Lights》的氛围曲。

interviewQuotes.text: We wanted the guitars to feel like New York at night—cold and close.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Daniel Kessler

interviewQuotes.text: Carlos made the low end as melodic as the vocals.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Paul Banks
